mechanism_claims.claim_text: Hp1404 analogs retain amphipathic alpha-helical structure in membrane-mimicking SDS/TFE environments; this supports membrane-active plausibility but is not by itself a killing mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD spectroscopy is structural context; it is not direct microbial killing evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Calcein-loaded LUV assays support peptide-induced membrane leakage in model lipid vesicles.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model vesicle leakage is mechanistic support, not a standalone bacterial viability endpoint.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NPN uptake assay directly supports outer membrane permeabilization in A. baumannii KCTC 2508, with 4x MIC fluorescence after 30 min approximately 600, 650, 540, 530 and 490 a.u. for Hp1404, Hp1404-V, Hp1404-L, Hp1404-I and Hp1404-W, respectively.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Values are approximate fluorescence intensities from source prose.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: DisC3-5 assay directly supports cytoplasmic membrane depolarization in A. baumannii, with 4x MIC fluorescence approximately 210, 200, 200, 220 and 260 a.u. for Hp1404, Hp1404-V, Hp1404-L, Hp1404-I and Hp1404-W, respectively.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Values are approximate fluorescence intensities from source prose.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Crystal violet, SYTO9 imaging and EPS assays support antibiofilm phenotype and reduced extracellular polymeric substance production, but they should not be promoted to a molecular mechanism beyond biofilm disruption context.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Hp1404 and analog peptides against A. baumannii strains
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic biofilm assays do not identify a single molecular target.

source_review_notes: Automated pending mechanism placeholders were replaced with source-located worker-6 adjudicated claims.
NPN and DisC3-5 are direct membrane mechanism assays; biofilm/EPS claims remain phenotypic and are not overpromoted.
